summary_1line: Bhima reaches Kuvera’s guarded lotus lake, defies the Rakshasas’ warning, fights them fiercely, and gathers the sacred Saugandhika lotuses for Draupadi.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima stands waist-deep in a shimmering lake of golden lotuses beneath the cliffs of Kailasa as armed Rakshasas rush toward him.
The mace‑wielding Bhima smashes through a circle of Rakshasas on the lotus lake’s bank while swans scatter across the water.
Hundreds of armored Rakshasas guard the radiant lotus lake beneath the shadow of Mount Kailasa, confronting the deer‑skin‑clad Bhima.
